page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with the page number on the left. Below it one column of running text, then a centred dateline in italics, then a centred division heading with a title and a second heading. The letter text follows below. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: neri me accingam, Deoqve juvante, ad diem, qvi mihi ab Eminentissimo Cardinale Bichio circa proximum Pascha condicendum est, expeditus ero, ut ipsius comitatui me posim[?] conjungere, præ-sensqve propensissimam & devotissimam obsequio tuo animi mei voluntatem, qvæ sola mihi gratitudinis demonstrandæ lux affulget, Eminentiæ tuæ consecrare. Deus te incolumem Ecclesiæ suæ, sacrisqve literis conservet qvàm diutisi-me, Eminentissime Cardinalis, faxit-qve, ut me tibi obsequentissimum amare pergas.
Datuu Parisiis Anno Salutis MDCXXXIX, vij id. Feb.
main_text.head: EPIST. LVII.
Lucæ Holstenii Commonitorium J. Mo-rino Romæ exeunti.
Commonitorium P. Johanni Morino.
main_text.p: C'L[?], Morine, Lucas Holstenius hoc te abeuntem rogat, ut amici ex animo tibi addictissimi memoriam serves, ut ami-

page.notes: The large initial C is followed by a mark that looks like an apostrophe before "L"; read uncertain. "Datuu" is printed as such and may be a printing error for "Datum". The word "posim" is partly unclear because the long s and f look alike in this print. "diutisi-" is read as printed. The line "Commonitorium P." uses italic type, and "Romæ exeunti." is roman. The running head is read from the top line. The digitiser's banner at the lower right is left out.
